params: "[{\"Field\":\"blacklist\",\"DefaultValue\":\"baidu.com,google.com,googleapis.com\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"域名黑名单\",\"Help\":\"设置域名黑名单，逗号分隔；匹配主域及其子域\",\"MethodType\":\"string\"},{\"Field\":\"param-blacklist\",\"DefaultValue\":\"name,token,csrf_token,session_id,timestamp,signature\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"参数名黑名单\",\"Help\":\"参数名黑名单，这些参数不检测SQL注入\",\"MethodType\":\"string\"},{\"Field\":\"url-suffix-blacklist\",\"DefaultValue\":\".png,.jpg,.jpeg,.gif,.css,.js,.ico,.svg,.woff,.woff2,.ttf,.eot,.pdf,.zip,.rar,.exe,.mp3,.mp4,.avi\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"URL后缀黑名单\",\"Help\":\"URL后缀黑名单，排除静态资源\",\"MethodType\":\"string\"},{\"Field\":\"path-blacklist\",\"DefaultValue\":\"/api/status,/health,/ping,/static,/assets,/images,/css,/js,/favicon.ico\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"路径黑名单\",\"Help\":\"路径黑名单，排除特定路径\",\"MethodType\":\"string\"},{\"Field\":\"param-value-blacklist\",\"DefaultValue\":\"true,false,1,0,yes,no,on,off\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"参数值黑名单\",\"Help\":\"参数值黑名单，排除常见布尔/标志值\",\"MethodType\":\"string\"},{\"Field\":\"min-param-value-length\",\"DefaultValue\":\"2\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"uint\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"最小参数值长度\",\"Help\":\"最小参数值长度，低于此值不检测\",\"MethodType\":\"uint\"},{\"Field\":\"max-concurrent\",\"DefaultValue\":\"5\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"uint\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"最大并发数\",\"Help\":\"最大并发请求数\",\"MethodType\":\"uint\"},{\"Field\":\"similarity-threshold-factor\",\"DefaultValue\":\"1\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"float\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"相似度阈值调整系数\",\"Help\":\"相似度阈值调整系数（0.5~2.0）\",\"MethodType\":\"float\"}]"
